caption: The drawing depicts a single sleeveless garment, specifically a red vest, centered on a plain, light beige background. The vest is composed of a textured fabric featuring wave-like horizontal patterns in varying shades of red, giving it a rippling appearance. The front of the vest is detailed with a vertical row of round buttons, brown in color, running down the center from the round neckline to the bottom edge. Decorative braiding or trim, also in a darker red or brown, runs along the sides of the buttons and is also present outlining the vest’s two angled flap pockets, located at the lower left and right sides near the hem. The inside lining of the vest, visible at the neck and bottom center opening, is a muted grayish or beige tone. The background is unadorned and does not contain any additional objects or decorations.
title: Wedding Vest
